integrations.title: Integrations
landing.a1: No. Statutory and Sharia grounds are taken from the corpus. A citation that is not in the corpus is rejected and is not saved.
landing.a2: Only you. Chats, documents, and memos are encrypted with your data key. The admin dashboard has no view of that content.
landing.a3: Five chats, PDF export, and the general and labor forums. A further memo can be paid for individually when a plan quota is used up.
landing.a4: Checkout opens a hosted payment page. The server verifies the callback before the wallet or the plan is updated. Invoices show VAT at 15 percent.
landing.courtsSubtitle: Choose the court before drafting. The plan controls which forums are included.
landing.f1Body: Open a separate conversation, upload the documents, and answer the questions that shape the draft.
landing.f2Body: Lawsuits and memos for general, criminal, personal status, labor, commercial, enforcement, administrative, appeal, and supreme courts.
landing.f3Body: A draft may cite an article only when that article was retrieved from the corpus, and every citation links to its record.
landing.f4Body: Revise the memo in the editor, then export an Arabic PDF or a Word file.
landing.f5Body: Hearings and objection deadlines, with reminders before the date.
landing.f6Body: Content is encrypted with a key unique to you. An administrator sees totals, not your files.
landing.featuresSubtitle: A workspace for the conversation, the papers, the memo, and the dates.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything the file needs, in one place
landing.heroCounsel: From the uploaded papers, the contract appears to have ended by the employer without written notice. Were the last wage and the end-of-service award paid?
landing.heroSubtitle: Upload the case file, answer a few clarifying questions, and receive a lawsuit, defense, reply, or appeal grounded only in sources stored in the verified corpus.
landing.heroTitle: Precise legal drafting, with a careful electronic counsel
landing.heroUser: The company ended my service after seven years without notice and did not pay the end-of-service award.

security.body: Chats, documents, and memos are encrypted with a key that belongs to the account. The admin console shows totals and does not read case text. Search stores a fingerprint of words, not the text. Files are scanned before they are kept. Payment uses Al Rajhi, and the shown price is inclusive.
